basic_profile.bio: I am a 32-year-old dog-loving mother-to-be residing in the Midwest. By day, I work as a graphic designer, and by night, I share my bed with my husband and our 80-pound golden retriever. I enjoy crafting and playing Minecraft in my spare time, and I have a knack for finding the most comfortable pillows in existence. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after dinner and before bedtime. I'm married and currently navigating the joys and challenges of pregnancy.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design, which I studied in college. I have a keen interest in interior design and home comfort, which I've nurtured through self-learning and DIY projects over the years. Additionally, I have a growing interest in prenatal health and parenthood as I prepare for my first child.
